name: HeroWalkRight
prompt: Edit target: existing right-facing walk sheet. Reference2: approved front hero design. Redraw the walk into a REAL coherent 8-frame WALK-IN-PLACE cycle, exactly 4 columns x 2 rows, reading row-major. Detailed Dark Fantasy pixel art, transparent background. Same black armor, dark hair, burgundy cape, sheathed weapon, same lighting and proportions across ALL frames. Critical correction: the old sheet incorrectly puts the same near leg forward in every contact pose. New frame0: near leg forward and far leg back, heel contact. Frame1: near-leg weight/down pose, far foot lifts behind. Frame2: near leg planted back, far knee passes forward. Frame3: far leg reaches forward, near heel lifts. Frame4: FAR LEG FORWARD and NEAR LEG BACK, opposite contact to frame0, clear wide reversed leg silhouette. Frame5: far-leg weight/down, near foot lifts behind. Frame6: far leg planted back, near knee passes forward. Frame7: near leg reaches forward leading smoothly into frame0. Arms counter-swing with legs; cape follows a quarter cycle late with small stable folds. Keep torso/head centered identically, only 2-pixel-equivalent natural bob. Same anatomical near/far legs remain identifiable via shading. True joint articulation and alternating foot contacts, never eight variations of the same leading leg. Feet ground line identical in each cell, generous empty gutters and margins; no shadow, grid, labels, text, motion blur, duplicate contact frames or cropping. Draw all eight distinct temporal poses, not a character lineup.
